servers.name: kiln
servers.description: KILN forge MCP, remote: JSON-RPC 2.0 POST, sessionless, plain-JSON responses. initialize, ping and tools/list need no credential. For tools/call writes and non-public reads, send Authorization: Bearer <KILN credential> (operator token, account session kiln_sess_…, or agent token kiln_agt_… with the forge scope).
servers.toolsDiscovery: POST {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"} to the endpoint, or GET the endpoint for the tool names and transport

servers.name: kiln-forge
servers.description: KILN forge MCP, local: spawn against the forge daemon's /v1 API for the full tool surface (kiln_workspace_*, kiln_repo_details, kiln_forge_*, kiln_papers_*, kiln_agent_*). Connection config: KILN_SWARM_DIR (daemon state dir), or KILN_SWARM_API_URL + KILN_SWARM_TOKEN.
